title: Bench Sales Recruiter
description:
Role: Bench Sales Recruiter
 



 Location: Uppal, Telangana.
 



 Shift Timing: Night shifts (EST hours)
 



  





 Job Description:
 



  





 Your primary responsibility will be to secure projects for our Fulltime/W2 candidates by leveraging Tier 1 contacts and various web portals, including Dice, Tech Fetch, Monster, CareerBuilder, and LinkedIn.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 As a Bench Sales Recruiter \-
 


* Collaborate closely with Team and management to align people strategies with business priorities, ensuring all people\-related initiatives effectively support the strategic direction.
* Build strong relationships with prime vendors and Tier 1 partners.
* Market L2S, Green Card and US Citizen's effectively.
* Coordinate interviews and manage communication between consultants and vendors.
* Follow up with vendors and client's post\-interview to ensure successful placement.
* Negotiate rates and contracts with corporate accounts and vendors.
* Analyze job requirements to assess candidates’ skillsets accurately.
* Use Boolean search strings to identify the best\-fit candidates quickly.
* Stay up\-to\-date with technical terminology across multiple technologies.
* Develop a strong vendor network to streamline candidate placements.
* Have a thorough understanding of W2, Fulltime and US tax terms.
* Manage the complete recruiting cycle, from sourcing to placement.
* Format resumes and follow up on feedback from clients.
* Prepare and submit daily/weekly reports to management.
* Meet monthly and annual recruiting targets set by the company.



  





 Required Experience, Skills \& Competencies:
 


* 0\-3 years of experience in IT/Consulting industry. Comprehensive knowledge of the principles and practices of Leading a team \- exposure to performance management and Employee experience management is a plus
* Ability to build effective relationships internally and externally. Collaborative approach across the organization to maximize outcomes
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills



  





 We will ensure that the compensation and title will be commensurate with the experience and skill\-level brought to the table.
 



 If you meet these qualifications and are interested in this opportunity, please send us your resume. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: OPT Recruiters
description:
**Company Description** 
**Maxon IT Solutions is a product\-driven technology company focused on building innovative, scalable, and intelligent digital solutions for modern businesses.** 




  





**We design and develop technology products that help organizations simplify operations, improve productivity, automate processes, and accelerate digital transformation. Our approach combines modern engineering, user\-focused design, and emerging technologies to create reliable products that solve real\-world business challenges.** 




  





**Role Description** 
 The OPT Recruiter role at Maxon IT Solutions is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kondapur. The OPT Recruiter will source, screen, and interview OPT candidates, maintain a strong pipeline of qualified talent, and coordinate the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle. Daily responsibilities include posting job openings, conducting initial candidate assessments, scheduling interviews, and managing communication with candidates throughout the hiring process. The role also involves building relationships with universities and training institutes, maintaining accurate recruitment records, and collaborating with internal teams to understand hiring needs and timelines. The OPT Recruiter is expected to ensure a positive candidate experience while meeting staffing goals and adhering to company policies and applicable regulations.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end recruitment, particularly with OPT or campus hiring, and talent sourcing through various channels.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain candidate and stakeholder relationships.
* Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems, job portals, and professional networking platforms to manage and track recruitment activities.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple requisitions and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Understanding of IT roles and skills, along with basic knowledge of OPT, CPT, and related immigration guidelines (experience with US staffing is a mandatory).
* Ability to work on\-site in Kondapur, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and uphold inclusive, non\-discriminatory hiring practices.
